newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares slightly up at noon, trade dull.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares slightly up at noon, trade dull.

text.p: Shanghai B shares were slightly up at midday on Tuesday with institutions seen backing some big shares, but trading was dull due to weak sentiment, dragged down by the poor performance of Jinan Qingqi Motorcycle Co, brokers said.
The B index edged up 0.179 points or 0.21 percent to 83.886 points on volume of 7.284 million shares worth $4.059 million.

The market outlook is not optimistic with large profit-taking in Jinan Qingqi despite institutional support buying in other shares, brokers said. They added that little fresh capital is seen flowing into the market.
The newcomer Jinan Qingqi was the most actively traded on profit-taking, dipping $0.012 or 2.18 percent to $0.538 on volume of 4.5 million shares.

"Sentiment is weakening with no fresh capital flowing into the market," said one broker. "A number of new B shares are expected to list in the near future, which will pump a lot of capital out of existing shares."
"The market will linger around current levels due to a lack of capital to support it," another broker said.
Of 44 B shares, 34 traded, with 12 up, five flat and 17 down.
Shanghai Erfangji was the star on speculative buying, up $0.006 or 4.84 percent to $0.130 on volume of 154,235 shares.
Shanghai Refrigerator Compressor followed, rising $0.016 or 2.99 percent to $0.550 on volume of 20,000 shares.
Shanghai's A share index was slightly up on institutional support, but investors are still cautious amid market uncertainties, brokers said.
The index put on 2.127 points or 0.16 percent to 1,303.249 on volume of 149.1 million shares worth 2.0 billion yuan.
The SSE30 blue chip index was up 28.876 points or 0.75 percent to 3,868.500 points.
Shanghai Erfangji was the biggest gainer on speculative buying, jumping 0.32 yuan or 7.44 percent to 4.62 yuan on volume of 1.5 million shares.
